paper.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints
paper.authors: DESI Collaboration (M. Abdul Karim et al.)
paper.pdf_note: arXiv v3 downloaded 2026-11-16. Equation numbers below are the arXiv numbering.

route.decision: Same route as our DESI 2024 VI rerun: we evaluate the likelihood ourselves on a dense deterministic grid and marginalise exactly. We do NOT re-analyse the published DESI chains.
route.why: The three targets are flat-LCDM background-only fits to a 13-element Gaussian likelihood that DESI published as plain text in CobayaSampler/bao_data. BAO alone samples (Omega_m, r_d h), BAO+BBN samples (Omega_m, H0, omega_b). With 2 and 3 parameters a grid is exact, has no sampling scatter and finishes in minutes on CPU.
route.reuse: The fit code, the CAMB version and the venv come from noturno/2024-desi-bao-vi, which reproduced the DR1 numbers. Only the data file and the target values change. This is stated here before the run: if DR2 fails where DR1 passed, the code is not the first suspect.
route.risk_accepted: Same three self-checks as DR1, fixed before running: (a) the data vector must equal Table 1 of the paper to the printed digits; (b) our distance integrals must agree with CAMB to better than 1e-4 relative; (c) chi-square at the best fit must be of order the degrees of freedom.

data.content: The DR2 BAO measurements: BGS DV/rd at z=0.295; LRG1 (DM/rd, DH/rd) at z=0.510; LRG2 at z=0.706; LRG3+ELG1 at z=0.934; ELG2 at z=1.321; QSO at z=1.484; Lya at z=2.330. DR2 has 13 points against DR1's 12, because QSO now gives DM and DH separately instead of DV. No login, no terms to accept.

model.name: flat LCDM, background only

fixed.massive_neutrinos: one massive species with m_nu = 0.06 eV, the paper's default

model.bbn_prior: omega_b h^2 = 0.02218 +/- 0.00055, Gaussian, eq. (14) of the paper. Identical to the DR1 prior.
model.r_d: drag-epoch sound horizon from CAMB get_derived_params()['rdrag'], the code the paper uses.

C1.what: Omega_m from DESI DR2 BAO alone, flat LCDM
C1.where: eq. (17), and the LCDM / DESI row of Table 3

C2.what: h * r_d from DESI DR2 BAO alone, flat LCDM, in Mpc

C3.what: H0 from DESI DR2 BAO + BBN prior on omega_b, flat LCDM, in km/s/Mpc
C3.careful: The paper gives two H0 values and they are easy to swap. Eq. (19), 68.51 +/- 0.58, is DESI+BBN: the conservative prior on omega_b alone, which is the only one our recipe implements. Eq. (20), 68.45 +/- 0.47, is DESI+BBN+, which also adds the CMB acoustic scale prior 100*theta* = 1.04110 +/- 0.00053. We are NOT reproducing eq. (20). This is written down before the run so the target cannot be picked after seeing the number.

tolerance.rule: Same ruler as the DR1 rerun: the mean has to land within 0.2 published sigma of the published mean, and our sigma within 10% of the published sigma. Both must hold for a claim to count as reproduced.
tolerance.edge_mass: A marginal with more than 1e-6 of its mass on the grid edge is reported as a grid failure, not as a result.

verdict_rule: 3 of 3 claims in band: Reproduced. 1 or 2: Partially reproduced. 0: Not reproduced.
